items.source: One approach uses transaction semantics defined in XML using the <tx:advice> elements, the other uses annotations in combination with the <tx:annotation-driven> element. Both approached are detailed to great extent in the Spring reference manual.
items.translation: 一种方法使用 XML 中定义的事务语义，采用 `<tx:advice>` 元素；另一种方法则结合注解与 `<tx:annotation-driven>` 元素。这两种方法在 Spring 参考手册中均有详尽的说明。

items.source:
This namespace handler is the central piece of functionality in the
Spring transaction management facilities and offers two approaches
to declaratively manage transactions.
items.translation: 该命名空间处理器是 Spring 事务管理设施的核心功能组件，提供了两种声明式管理事务的方法。

items.source: Invoked by the DefaultBeanDefinitionDocumentReader after construction but before any custom elements are parsed.
items.translation: 由DefaultBeanDefinitionDocumentReader在构造后但在解析任何自定义元素之前调用。
